name: Weekend Event at WOW Porto
description: The World of Wine cultural district hosts a weekend of music, street food, and entertainment with panoramic views of Porto.
longDescription:
The World of Wine (WOW) cultural district in Gaia presents a weekend event on June 20th and 21st, 2026, focusing on evening entertainment. This initiative by WOW Porto aims to activate its public spaces with a program of live music and culinary offerings, providing a social gathering point for both residents and visitors to the Porto metropolitan area. The event utilizes the district's open-air setting overlooking the Douro River.

Attendees can expect an atmosphere centered around live musical performances and a selection of street food vendors. The event is designed for a general audience, offering a relaxed setting for evening leisure. The venue, WOW Porto, is a large-scale cultural and hospitality complex situated on the south bank of the Douro, providing elevated perspectives of the city of Porto across the river.

Entry to the event is free of charge, with no prior booking required. WOW Porto is located in Gaia, accessible via a walk across the Luís I Bridge from Porto's riverside Ribeira district. Public transport options include local bus services to Gaia.
